dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder's Notes
dialogues.text: "...Are you serious? I managed to follow the treasure map to this place, but I ran into the miasma... and then got chased across three mountains by some crazed monsters..."

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder's Notes
dialogues.text: "...They say that the second key in this area has yet to be found, and that the first is now lost. Just my luck... Just my rotten luck!"

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder's Notes
dialogues.text: "...I still need to make up an excuse for the boss. Hmm. I know! I'll just say that I found the treasure, but it was completely empty! It was all a load of tripe made up to trick fools by a bunch of stinkin', stupid liars..."
